import hashlib,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('udt_gw170817_fixed_window_test_campaign_2026-09-07')

s1=p/'step_01';s2=p/'step_02'

r2=json.loads((s2/'review/REVIEW_RESULT.json').read_text())
ready=json.loads((s2/'AUTHOR_REPAIR_READY.json').read_text())

assert sha(s1/'CANDIDATE.md')==r1['candidate_sha256']
assert sha(s1/'FREEZE.json')==r1['freeze_sha256']==r2['freeze_unchanged_sha256']
for key,name in ready['artifact_paths'].items():
 assert sha(s2/name)==ready[key+'_sha256'],key
for key,rec in ready['initial_preservation'].items():
 assert sha(s2/rec['path'])==rec['sha256'] and rec['initial_pin_matches'],key
for key in ['candidate','producer','evaluation','coefficients']:
 assert r2[key+'_sha256']==ready[key+'_sha256']
assert sha(s2/'AUTHOR_REPAIR_READY.json')==r2['author_repair_ready_sha256']
assert sha(s2/'review/FINAL_REVIEW.md')=='37485eeaeb63bc3ddf0654d19a1f79215307c2f165d43481f522ae96e2770f79'
assert sha(s2/'review/REVIEW_RESULT.json')=='da021c21c456cd98c87fb020731e5468239b35c9350ea1de6d904242319f6f2c'
assert sha(s2/'review'/r2['independent_result_path'])==r2['independent_result_sha256']
ind=json.loads((s2/'review'/r2['independent_result_path']).read_text())
out=json.loads((s2/ready['artifact_paths']['evaluation']).read_text())
counts=[round(f['target_crossing_fraction']*168) for f in out['families']]
assert counts==ind['target_direct_counts_out_of_168']==r2['target_direct_counts_out_of_168']==[5,3,3]
assert ind['direct_target_recomputations']==504 and not out['survives_all_families']
assert not r2['event_samples_read'] and not r2['event_unseal_cleared'] and not r2['scientific_promotion']
audit=json.loads((p/'STARTUP_PREMISE_AUDIT.json').read_text())
assert audit['returncode']==0 and not audit['timeout'] and audit['stderr']==''
assert 'PASS: 349-row premise registry' in audit['stdout']
assert sha(p/'STARTUP_PREMISE_AUDIT.json')=='f775459039552d8604e4f9efd1777217611506b6e872c1f75d898cda5f513d38'
for name in ['method_R1_singlethread_run','catch_R1_singlethread_run','endpoint_catch_run','evaluation_R1_run']:
 rec=json.loads((s2/(name+'.json')).read_text())
 assert rec['returncode']==0 and not rec['timeout'] and (s2/(name+'.stderr')).read_text()==''
for name in ['method_R1_run','catch_R1_run']:
 assert json.loads((s2/(name+'.json')).read_text())['returncode']==-9
print(json.dumps(dict(scope='packaging, exact reviewed-version and saved-result consistency; not new scientific review',FW1=r1['verdict'],FW2=r2['verdict'],initial_evidence_preserved=True,reviewed_pins_match=True,counts=counts,event_unexamined=True,scientific_promotion=False,full349_audit_replayed=False,full349_saved_PASS_verified=True,failed_execution_records_preserved=True),indent=2))
